description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Holy 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Last Stand] and [Knightslayer Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: Knightslayer Mode
description.text: Removed when HP fall below 20%, casts Climb Break when removed
